s0085 has 己未劾免 after 賀壽慈’s appointment: 劾免 is removal upon impeachment, not a person 劾; 未任 after 陳蘭彬 means he did not assume the post. The proposed idiomatic fixes both errors and correctly attributes the actions.

decisions.reason: s0096 陳蘭彬夏家鎬仍署 lists two officials with 仍署: Chen as the continuing holder and Xia continuing to act. The before fuses the names into broken English; the proposed semicolon wording matches the Chinese.
s0105 has 未任 after 曾紀澤 and later 十二月癸未改署, where 改署 means the acting appointment was changed, not a person named 改. The proposed idiomatic corrects both misreadings.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 未任。徐用儀署。十二月癸未改署

decisions.reason: s0106 opens 陳蘭彬夏家鎬四月乙巳遷: two persons transferred, not one fused name. 十二月遷 then refers to the acting appointee 許庚身. The proposed split and “he was transferred” match the Chinese sequence.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 陳蘭彬夏家鎬四月乙巳遷……十二月遷

decisions.reason: s0116 曾紀澤張家驤四月丙戌遷 are two men transferred; 十一月癸巳休致 follows 王之翰署 and marks Wang’s retirement. The proposal unfuses the names and supplies the retirement subject correctly.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 曾紀澤張家驤四月丙戌遷。王之翰署左副都御史。十一月癸巳休致

decisions.reason: s0127 曾紀澤張佩綸仍署 parallels other dual-name 仍署 cells: Zeng continues as holder and Zhang Peilun continues acting. The proposed wording repairs the fused broken English.
s0148 吳大澂沈源深仍署 likewise names Wu as continuing holder and Shen as continuing actor. The proposed idiomatic restores that reading from the garbled before text.
s0149 has 十一月丙申改署 then 戊申徐樹銘署: 改署 is changing the acting appointment, not a person 改. The proposal also supplies the missing subject for 八月差 (Hu Ruilan).

sourceWitness.excerpt: 八月差……十一月丙申改署。戊申徐樹銘署左副都御史

decisions.reason: s0192 八月壬寅差 after 沈源深’s appointment means he was sent on assignment; 十一月丁未遷 then refers to acting 錢應溥. Leaving bare 差 is incomplete; the proposed subjects match the Chinese sequence.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 八月壬寅差。錢應溥署左副都御史。十一月丁未遷

decisions.after: Xue Fucheng; Shouchang continued to serve in an acting capacity.
decisions.reason: s0234 薛福成壽昌仍署 does name two men with 仍署, so the fused before text is wrong; but “For Xue Fucheng’s post” invents an unfilled-post gloss not stated in this cell. Use the same dual-name 仍署 pattern as elsewhere: Xue as holder, Shouchang continuing to act.
The literal must also separate 薛福成 from 壽昌 under 仍署. “Xue Fucheng: Shouchang still served in an acting capacity” correctly distinguishes the appointee from the continuing acting official.
s0265 楊儒……未任 means Yang Ru did not assume office; 馮文蔚署……十二月卒 makes Feng the subject of the twelfth-month death. The proposed idiomatic supplies both missing readings without inventing other actors.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 楊儒左副都御史。未任。馮文蔚署左副都御史。十二月卒

decisions.reason: s0301 sequence 懷塔布理藩院尚書。十二月戊戌卒 then 世續……十二月丙寅遷 assigns the death to Huaitabu and the later transfer to Shixu. The proposed subjects restore that narrative linkage.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 懷塔布理藩院尚書。十二月戊戌卒。辛丑世續理藩院尚書。十二月丙寅遷
